info.title: Ubiquity (FilterLabs) -- endpoints exercised by the ubiquity-* skill family
info.description: Reverse-engineered from live traffic across the ubiquity-auth, ubiquity-pipeline-creation, ubiquity-entity-review, ubiquity-discovery-jobs, ubiquity-agent-settings, ubiquity-metric-generators, ubiquity-understand-layer, ubiquity-ubi-chat, ubiquity-pipeline-routing, and ubiquity-data-feed-api skills. NOT an official spec -- confirm against the live backend before depending on exact field presence; several fields observed live are undocumented elsewhere (see each skill's Pitfalls section). v1.1.0: added search/unified refine-loop fields, Import Sources (sources/upload + dataset-upload workflow), entity split-preview/split, additional feed interval fields, and flagged filter_prompt/filter_distance + route filter_mode/filter_config as accepted-on-write but UNVERIFIED-in-effect (see each schema's description).

servers.description: Keycloak auth server (realm filter-labs-web, client web-app)

post.summary: Login / token refresh (Keycloak ROPC + refresh_token grants)

Parse a free-text query into LOCATION/TOPIC/entity-type entities. ALSO serves as the chat-refine endpoint -- there is no separate 'send a chat message' call for the pre-confirmation Discover chat (Change Location / Add <place> / Adjust Topics / etc. all re-call this same endpoint with prior_query/prior_entities/prior_context/session_id added).

prior_query.description: REFINE TURNS ONLY: previous turn's query string, verbatim

prior_entities.description: REFINE TURNS ONLY: previous turn's parsed_entities object, verbatim

prior_context.description: REFINE TURNS ONLY: previous turn's context_report string, verbatim

session_id.description: REFINE TURNS ONLY: previous turn's response session_id, verbatim

200.description: existing_sources[], discovery_job_id, parsed_entities{locations,topics,entity_types,persons,organizations,events}, context_report, suggestions[], stats, location{id,name,country,coordinates,bounding_box,is_multi_location,component_locations}, entity_changes{added,removed,modified}, confidence, reasoning, query, session_id

get.summary: List pipelines

post.summary: Create a pipeline (fires after 'Yes, Discover Sources')

200.description: pipeline object: id, feed_id, session_id, metadata.discovery_config, metadata.agent_config, search_filters

get.summary: Get a pipeline (feed_id, agent_config, discovery_config, search_filters)

patch.summary: Update metadata.agent_config / discovery_config (Agent Settings save) -- whole metadata object must be re-sent, not a partial diff

custom_instructions.description: CONFIRMED key for the Search Generation Agent's free-text 'Custom Instructions' field

get.summary: List pipeline routes (fan-in/fan-out)

200.description: array, each with source/destination_pipeline_name + feed_id denormalized

post.summary: Create a route from this (source) pipeline to a destination pipeline

filter_mode.description: ACCEPTED ON WRITE (e.g. 'liked_only' is echoed back and persisted), but EFFECT UNVERIFIED -- a live test did not observe entities flowing differently after setting this and triggering sync within ~20s. No UI control exists for this field; API-only.

filter_config.description: Same caveat as filter_mode -- accepted and persisted, effect on actual routing unverified.

201.description: route object: id, source_pipeline_id, destination_pipeline_id, enabled, filter_mode, filter_config

post.summary: Like / dislike / flag an entity (true toggle -- repeating the same vote_type un-votes it)

keycloak_user_id.description: Keycloak user UUID (JWT 'sub' claim), NOT the email

get.summary: List current votes for a pipeline

200.description: array of vote objects, [] if none

get.summary: List discovered entities (sources/datasets) for a feed. Also the basis of CSV export -- 'Download CSV' is purely client-side: it calls this endpoint with limit=1000/offset=0 (no type/q/order_by) plus GET /locations/v1/entity-votes/pipeline/{pipeline_id}?limit=500, and joins them into a CSV in-browser. No dedicated export endpoint exists.

schema.description: CONFIRMED plural form 'sources'; 'datasets' inferred by the same pattern, not independently confirmed live (test feed had 0 datasets)

delete.summary: Remove an entity from a feed (hard delete)

get.summary: AI-cluster an entity's source URLs by apparent topic, as a preview before splitting. Slow (several seconds, AI clustering) -- use fire-and-forget when calling via browser automation. Observed one flaky 'No split needed' result under rapid repeated calls; treat as retry-worthy if a mismatch is suspected.

200.description: {entity_id, entity_name, total_sources, groups: [{group_name, source_count, source_ids[], urls[], is_keeper}], discarded_urls[], feeds_affected[]}. is_keeper does NOT reliably land on the semantically-matching group -- inspect per call.

post.summary: DESTRUCTIVE, cross-feed: commit a split previewed above. The entity_id's original row keeps whichever group was is_keeper in the preview (name is NOT auto-updated to match); every other group becomes a brand-new entity linked to every feed the original was in.

groups.description: same groups the preview returned, trimmed to just group_name+source_ids

200.description: {original_entity_id, original_entity_sources_kept, new_entities: [{id, uuid, name, source_count}], discarded_urls[], feeds_linked[]}

get.summary: Get a single entity's raw record (location, metadata as base64, timestamps)
Full free-text AI evaluation reasoning for a discovered source, keyed by its URL

post.summary: Import Sources -- Plain Text and CSV Upload sub-flows (both hit this one endpoint, differing only in payload shape). CSV parsing/preview happens CLIENT-SIDE before this call; this endpoint always just takes a final URL list. Async -- returns 202 immediately, no confirmed polling endpoint for job_id's own progress captured yet.

urls.description: Plain Text sub-flow: array of raw URL strings

urls_with_metadata.description: CSV Upload sub-flow: array of {url, name?} objects, mutually exclusive with urls

202.description: {job_id, feed_id, url_count, valid_urls, invalid_urls, status: processing, message}

post.summary: Import Sources -- Behavioral Dataset sub-flow. Entirely separate endpoint family from sources/upload. Multipart file upload (jsonl/csv/xlsx, max 25MB) plus form fields read off the live UI form.

dataset_external_id.description: optional, defaults to auto-generated-from-filename if omitted

multipart/form-data.description: exact multipart field name the file itself is attached under was not isolated by this skill's fetch/XHR interceptor (FormData bodies aren't serialized readably by it) -- inspect a raw HTTP capture if scripting this outside the browser

200.description: job object: {job_id, status: pending, progress: 0.0, dataset_id: null, series_names: [], observations_stored: 0, skipped_rows: 0, warnings: [], error: null, created_at, updated_at, completed_at: null}

get.summary: Poll a Behavioral Dataset upload job. Confirmed lifecycle pending(0.0) -> running(0.5) -> completed(1.0) within ~3s for a trivial file.

200.description: same shape as trigger's response; on completion: dataset_id populated, series_names derived from the file's non-date column header(s), observations_stored/skipped_rows/warnings populated

post.summary: Launch a discovery/curation job (ONLY call that actually starts agentic work -- see ubiquity-discovery-jobs for the never-stack-jobs rule)

get.summary: Poll a job's status/progress

200.description: job echoed with status=cancelled, completed_at set

get.summary: List jobs across the account
Total job count
Job count by status
Async sub-task progress for a job

200.description: {job_id, pending_count, processed_count, failed_count, total_count, all_complete, has_async_work, snapshots}

get.summary: Get feed (refresh_interval as human string, e.g. '12 hours')

put.summary: Full update -- used for rename, Data Refresh Interval (same underlying field as 'Enable Ubi' toggle), and several UI-less interval/review fields. This is a full PUT, not a partial PATCH -- omitted fields (including the feed's own metadata object) get wiped to null/default, so GET first and re-send unchanged fields.

name.description: must be re-sent, this is a full PUT not a partial PATCH

deletion_detection_interval_minutes.description: CONFIRMED settable via direct PUT; no UI control; actual background-job effect not independently verified

engagement_detection_interval_minutes.description: CONFIRMED settable via direct PUT; no UI control; actual background-job effect not independently verified

automatic_entity_rediscovery_interval_mi.description: CONFIRMED settable via direct PUT; no UI control; actual background-job effect not independently verified

force_review_for_auto_discover.description: CONFIRMED settable via direct PUT; no UI control

backdate_limit.description: CONFIRMED type is int32 (NOT a date string -- sending YYYY-MM-DD 400s). Likely a day-count given the name and that it isn't struct-wrapped like the true intervals, but exact unit unconfirmed.

200.description: feed with refresh_interval{Microseconds,Days,Months,Valid} struct (same struct shape for every *_interval field above), refreshed_at

get.summary: List metric generators for a feed (null if none)

post.summary: Create (and, via the Angular edit form, functionally also edit) a metric generator

filter_prompt.description: PLANNED FEATURE, not UI-exposed: accepted and persisted on write. Reasoned (not confirmed) purpose: a semantic pre-filter prompt gating which artifacts get scored by this metric. An earlier claim of a confirmed live effect was retracted -- it was based on a single happenstance before/after reading with no baseline/control/repeat. Treat as accepted-but-unverified-in-effect.

filter_distance.description: PLANNED FEATURE, same caveat as filter_prompt -- reasoned likely purpose is a vector-distance/similarity cutoff for that pre-filter, not confirmed by observed effect.

200.description: metric prompt object: id, feed_id, name, metric_name, prompt, filter_prompt, filter_distance, active, created_at, updated_at

put.summary: Edit a metric generator directly (preferred over driving the Angular edit modal -- no partial PATCH support, this resource only takes full PUT)

get.summary: List Ubi chat sessions for a user+feed

parameters.name: keycloak_user_id
parameters.description: the account EMAIL here, not the Keycloak UUID -- opposite convention from entity-votes/toggle

200.description: [] or array of session objects with filter_state auto-derived from the first message

post.summary: Create a chat session (fires lazily on first message, not on 'New Chat' click)

get.summary: Get one session's metadata
Read message history for a session

200.description: array: {id, session_id, role, content, citations[{id,url,score,title}], chart{type,title,config}, created_at}

post.summary: Send a message, get Ubi's reply (also implicitly creates the session on the first call). This is a DIFFERENT chat system from /orchestrator/search/unified's refine loop above -- this one is the standing per-feed Understand-tab chat, that one is discovery-time query parsing/refinement.

200.description: assistant message object; response latency ~15-25s plain, ~40s+ for chart requests

get.summary: Count ingested artifacts for a feed. CONFIRMED UNRELIABLE -- observed returning the identical value for multiple different feeds including one with zero real content. Use artifacts/preview's total_count instead.

200.description: {count, feed_id} -- do not trust as per-feed

post.summary: Fetch artifacts for the Data Browser table + default 'Sample Distribution' chart. limit is accepted but NOT honored server-side -- always returns up to a fixed 1000-item cap.

200.description: {artifacts: [{id, headline, url, site_type, published_at, content_sample, score}], total_count}

500.description: 'Collection <email> doesn't exist' -- normal/expected before any artifacts have been ingested yet, not a real error

post.summary: Fetch a custom metric's time series + per-artifact scores for the Data Browser chart. No result cap (unlike artifacts/preview) -- pulls the maximum matching data, hence slow; always scope with filter_state.dateRange. Fire-and-forget pattern required when calling from browser automation (response can take ~45s-150s+).

200.description: {data: [{artifact_uuid, score, list}], series: [{bucket, score}], total_count, filter_applied}

get.summary: Direct Data Feed (Curator Locations) API -- raw content items, full corpus (no 1000-item display cap), for Hermes-side direct reasoning/analysis over feed content. See ubiquity-data-feed-api.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: UNCONFIRMED advancement behavior -- see skill pitfalls

get.summary: Free-text location/POI search (not a curated country/region list)
Get a (possibly synthesized COMBINED-) location object

put.summary: Re-save the pipeline's saved search_query/search_filters (fired as part of the coverage-level launch sequence)
